elevation.adminHint: Argus is running as administrator and can view and end almost every process
elevation.serviceHint: Argus runs as a standard user; the privileged service carries out what needs administrator rights
elevation.standardHint: Some system processes need administrator rights to read or end

minimized.title: Refresh more often while minimized?
minimized.body: While its window is minimized, Argus will sample every process and sensor every {seconds} s. Intervals under 5 seconds noticeably increase CPU use and power draw, especially on battery. History and rules work fine at the default 5 seconds.

tray.title: Refresh more often in the tray?
tray.body: While hidden in the tray, Argus will sample every process and sensor every {seconds} s. Intervals under 5 seconds noticeably increase CPU use and power draw, especially on battery. History and rules work fine at the default 5 seconds.

notice.minimized: While the window was minimized, Argus refreshed every {to} s instead of every {from} s to save resources.
notice.tray: While Argus was in the tray, it refreshed every {to} s instead of every {from} s to save resources.
